Name: Feenie's Dog Recolor
Author: Feenie13
Description:
Another dog recolor mod of sorts. This is based off a pet of mine, Henry the beagle mix! The coloring on the paws is intentionally uneven, before I get questions about it.

To install:

[list=1]
[*]Make a back-up of your Stardew Valley/Content Folder, get XNB loader, or use ModDrop
[*]Drag and drop dog.xnb into your Content/Animals folder, or ModContent if you're using XNB Loader
[*]Run and enjoy!
[/list]
Please let me know if you have any questions about the mod.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
